messages:
maria: FYI I'm starting the py/ts SDK publish for 0.29.0 now. will try to keep window quiet.
aj: thanks — publishing in quiet window, tagging release notes after wheels land.
deploy-bot: publish-job-3921 started for package redwood-sdk-py@0.29.0 (sha: abc123). logs at https://ci.internal/builds/3921 :robot_face:
maria: wheel build passed on macos/linux, checksum looks different than last release though, std checksum: 9f8c... vs 7a3d...
sam: hm that checksum diff is expected if we rebuilt native extension with newer toolchain. are we sure it's the correct binary?
maria: yes it's the same c ext version. but pip index shows 403 for the linux wheel when installing in ephemeral test env. reproducing locally now.
jen: tagging hold if install fails in canary. we should not flip final tag until we validate installs in fresh envs.
aj: agree. what's failing exactly? paste log.
maria: ```ERROR: Could not fetch URL https://artifacts.internal/redwood-sdk-py-0.29.0.whl: 403 Client Error: Forbidden for url```
kevin: artifact perms maybe — deploy-bot usually uploads then sets ACL. deploy-bot, can you check upload step?
deploy-bot: upload step complete, artifact created at s3://redwood-builds/3921/redwood-sdk-py-0.29.0.whl, ACL set to private. publishing flow expected to set public-read for CDN keys, but key rotation detected on artifact-uploader role 1755; auto-fallback disabled.
sam: ok that explains 403. do we want to rollback the publish tag while we fix ACL?
jen: yes — pin prev stable 0.28.4 as latest on index and mark 0.29.0 as withheld. we should also add deprecation note draft for sync client changes included in 0.29.0 so users aren't surprised when we republish.
maria: I can patch ACL and re-run upload, but that'll change wheel checksum again if we recompile. prefer to re-upload same binary if possible to keep checksum stable.
kevin: reuploading same file should be fine. please keep the same object SHA. if we need rebuild, we should bump minor and call it 0.29.1 instead.
aj: for rollback action: jen, can you flip index pointer back to 0.28.4 and add a release note placeholder? then create a small internal incident with severity low and assign to infra for ACL fix.
jen: on it. flipping index now. :white_check_mark:
jen: index updated — latest -> 0.28.4, 0.29.0 marked withheld. added release-note draft: "0.29.0 held due to artifact ACL; users on sync client see planned deprecation of legacy sync methods, migration to async client described in docs."
sam: thanks. maria, when you reupload please ping here. we should also prepare a short deprecation notice email for high-usage customers and update SDK changelog with migration snippet: ```from redwood import AsyncClient  # migrate from SyncClient -> AsyncClient```
maria: will do. reupload scheduled in 30m after infra rotates credentials. if creds rotation introduces new checksum we will bump to 0.29.1 and update changelog accordingly.
kevin: also add a note in console rollout docs about canary windows — we need to block index flips until canary install passes.
aj: good call. I'll add a one-line gating rule to shiproom checklist: "confirm clean install from pip in fresh VM".
jen: internal customers: tagging slack #partners and ops to heads-up once reupload is done.
deploy-bot: publish-job-3921 status: paused (awaiting artifact ACL fix).
sam: ok closing this thread for now, keep updates here. small followups in 30m. :hourglass: 
maria: update — creds rotated, reupload succeeded, test install passed in ubuntu20 VM. if no objections I'll bump tag back to latest and un-withhold.
jen: LGTM from infra side. canary install passed for 10 quick installs. proceeding to flip.
aj: flipping index to 0.29.0 now. :gear:
deploy-bot: publish-job-3921 status: completed, latest tag -> 0.29.0. changelog pushed to docs repo.
kevin: follow-up actions: add deprecation blurb to migration guide, run smoke clients for a day, and consider a 0.29.1 if we end up with multiple artifact rebuilds this sprint.
sam: thanks everyone, nice coordination. we can close once changelog email goes out.
jen: email queued to partners list with link to changelog and migration snippet. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
